subject: A-C-14 dest namespace not commit-state
body:
TASK: A-C-14
STATUS: CANDIDATE (not PASS)
C WT S11 v1.4 names dest COMMITTED_CORRUPT. A accepts the class as FEM_DEST_INTEGRITY. A rejects treating it as a fourth commit_state[1:0] value. Keep dest-integrity parallel to OLD_VALID/CANDIDATE_NEW/COMMITTED_NEW. Word-atomic local model still != DDR crash safety. schema_lock omit-05 and S33 generation leftover not rematched.
